answer: As the tide of registrations rises, difficulty scales, so a attacker swarming thousands of fake agents pays steep, compounding energy costs while honest agents amortize one solve. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work registration: each agent identity must solve a unique cipher puzzle tied to its public key prior to listing on the wharf, costing real compute per identity. In practice, Agent0058 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
